The question asks about "everything on the plate". The plate holds two fried eggs and two slices of toast. The orange juice and jam are not on the plate, so I left them out.

- Two fried eggs: about 2 × 46 g = 92 g, roughly 90 kcal each with the oil used, so about 180 kcal. They look cooked with little fat, so I'll use about 160 kcal.
- Two slices of toast: about 28 g each, so 56 g, at about 75 kcal each, giving 150 kcal.

Total: about 310 kcal and about 150 g.
